SUCCESS: A live browser is now automating "User explicitly requests a Gemini re-verification of their just-deployed practice-room fix. Use the already saved Google login in this exact profile. This is ONE new review task, with at most ONE sent Gemini business message and ZERO automatic resend/retry. Do not buy/upgrade anything or change sharing.

Open a new Gemini chat. Inspect current UI, ensure signed-in. Inspect model menu and select the user's previously requested "4 Argon（代码与分析）" (actual displayed matching Argon; do NOT substitute Pro/Flash). Report the actual selected label. If that model is unavailable, login/security/permission/quota blocks access, or meaningful progress stops, return the exact blocker and STOP without sending.

Explicitly attach from Google Drive this newly uploaded private text file using the composer attachment/plus menu > add from Drive (not mere URL paste): exact title Gemini_R24_Smooth_Frozen_Input_20261116.txt, file id 1oxkQNsOlflinNBRU-r7sswsgrmfweHus, https://drive.google.com/file/d/1oxkQNsOlflinNBRU-r7sswsgrmfweHus/view?usp=drivesdk . Search by exact title if needed, select this one file and confirm attach; do not pick the old b086 attachment or the previous Drive delivery ZIP. The file is 489478 bytes. Verify its attachment chip is in this NEW chat before sending. Do not alter Drive access or browse unrelated personal chats/files. Do not send if attachment cannot be mounted.

Once the selected model and attachment are verified, send exactly this one business message:
--- BEGIN MESSAGE ---
任务 TCL-R24-SMOOTH-GEMINI-20261116。请独立复验已明确附加的最新版冻结输入；只读审查，不修改或部署。
用户报告练播、切题、录音时卡顿，并要求避免页面意外缩放。本版已上线：https://lijianjun004-star.github.io/tcl-v43-preview/tcl-v352-asr-r24-qa/ 。不要用旧b086或question-bank交付包替代附件。
先核验实际读取：返回附件里的随机读取校验字段和值；从源码准确引用复制PCM给Worker的表达式、以及允许构建逐题复盘表的入口条件。文件无法读取就明确写无法读取，勿根据我的说明推测。
重点复核：1. 隐藏题表按需渲染会否漏更新/丢回答；2. 16px规则、焦点/视口、双击触摸及动态键盘会否仍意外放大或跳动；3. Worker的加载、镜像、推理串行、PCM转移、超时/取消/错误及迟到结果会否卡住或串题；4. 录音→快速切题→结束→复盘→刷新恢复，人工改答/清空及跨标签冲突；5. 已有合成测试能证明什么、不能证明什么，找被测试遗漏的真实风险。
请按证据回答，不预设通过。给出每项证实的P1/P2缺陷（文件/函数/行号或准确源码、触发条件、证据、最小修复和必要测试），另列推测、未验证及发布结论。区分你本次实际运行、只读源码和Codex既有记录；有能力则执行附件内可复现检查并保留命令/环境/退出码，不能执行则明确仅静态审查。不能把桌面模拟当手机Safari/Android真机或把纯音模型smoke当TCL语音准确率。无缺陷也须明确边界。不要购买额度、调用收费API、请求账号凭证、变分享权限、修改任何项目文件或启动后台任务。只发这一条业务请求，不自动重试；本次结束后返回完整报告。
--- END MESSAGE ---

Wait for Gemini's COMPLETE response in that same chat. Do not send followups, regenerate, switch models, or pretend a browser run success is a Gemini review success. Return the complete verbatim response (not your paraphrase) and exact new chat URL, selected model label, attached filename, sent-message count, whether readback fields were answered, any real tool/execution evidence visible, and any blocker. Preserve any refusal verbatim. Do not interpret test records as your or Gemini's new executions. Stop after collecting the full response." on https://gemini.google.com/app — the user can see it running in the widget above this message. Now call wait_for_run with run_id "b5c0f550-a224-4b85-a2ac-3e22c4623cc7" and keep calling it while status is pending or running. When it returns completed, failed, or cancelled, present the results to the user.

CRITICAL: Do NOT say you cannot browse the web. Do NOT suggest the user paste content. Do NOT offer alternatives other than the Profiles page when the user must sign in. The tool IS browsing the web right now. Do NOT call run_web_automation again for this task.

If the user needs to sign in, never ask for a password in chat. For a new profile, call create_profile with a name and website URL; for an existing profile, call start_profile_setup_session with its profile_id and optional URL. Then follow the next_step it returns. If profiles are unavailable, send them to https://agent.tinyfish.ai/profiles.
